blocks.text: Introduction (ta'aruf)

Is chapter mein students Python ke built-in GUI toolkit Tkinter se aasan istemal wale (user-friendly) Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) banana seekhenge. Woh windows, frames, labels, buttons aur entry fields banayenge, aur pack(), grid() aur place() se layout (widgets ki tarteeb) sambhalenge. Woh event handling ki mashq karenge, yani user ke kaam (jaise click) ko functions se jorna, aur aik saada login form banayenge. Chapter mein database ke concepts, SQL, Python ko database se jorna (connectivity) aur SQLite ya MySQL ke saath bunyadi CRUD operations bhi hain.
4.1 Tkinter se Graphical User Interface (GUI) banana

GUI development programs ko nazar aane wale hisson (visual elements), jaise windows, buttons, labels aur text boxes, ke zariye user se baat cheet karne deti hai (Figure 4.1). Command-line interface ke muqable mein GUI applications ko istemal karna aasan banati hai. Python GUI applications achhi tarah banane ke tools deta hai. Tkinter Python ki built-in library hai jis se GUI programs bante hain. Yeh saada hai, bohat istemal hoti hai, aur developers ko jaldi interactive applications banane deti hai.

blocks.alt: Simple GUI Example naam ki window, minimise, maximise aur close buttons ke saath. Andar oopar khaali text field, aik Button, lafz Label, aur kai lines wala bara text box hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.1: Graphical User Interface (GUI) (kitab ki Figure 4.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: GUI kya hai? Yeh kyun zaroori hai?

GUI (Graphical User Interface) aik visual interface hai jis mein user buttons, menus aur forms jaisi cheezon se software chalata hai. GUI is liye zaroori hai ke yeh programs ko samajhna aur chalana aasan banata hai, khaas taur par un logon ke liye jo takneeki maahir nahi (non-technical users). Yeh screen par fauran nateeja dikha kar (visual feedback) aur mushkil commands yaad rakhne ki zaroorat kam kar ke istemal (usability) behtar karta hai. GUI applications desktop software, web applications aur mobile apps mein aam hain.
Tkinter: Python ka built-in GUI toolkit

Tkinter Python ka standard GUI toolkit hai jo Python ke saath hi install hota hai. Is mein classes aur functions hain jin se windows, buttons, labels, entry fields aur doosre widgets bante hain. Tkinter seekhna aasan hai, halka (lightweight) hai, aur event-driven programming deta hai, yani kaam user ke events (jaise click) se shuru hote hain. Yeh chhoti aur darmiyani GUI applications jaldi banane ke liye munasib hai.
Misal (Example):

import tkinter as tk
# Create main window
window = tk.Tk()
window.title("Simple GUI Example")
window.geometry("300x200")

# Function to handle button click (event)
def on_click():
    label.config(text="Button Clicked!")

# Create a label
label = tk.Label(window, text="Welcome to Tkinter")
label.pack(pady=10)

# Create an entry field
entry = tk.Entry(window)
entry.pack(pady=10)

# Create a button
button = tk.Button(window, text="Click Me", command=on_click)
button.pack(pady=10)

# Run the application
window.mainloop()

blocks.alt: Simple GUI Example window ka output: Welcome to Tkinter label, us ke neeche khaali entry field, aur Click Me button.
blocks.caption: Saada GUI misal ka output (kitab mein code ke saath chhapi window ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Tk() → main window banata hai; title() aur geometry() us ka naam aur size (300 x 200 pixels) set karte hain.
Label → text dikhata hai.
Entry → user se input leta hai.
Button → kaam karta hai.
command=on_click → event handling: button dabane par on_click() chalta hai aur label ka text 'Button Clicked!' ho jata hai.
mainloop() → GUI chalata hai aur window khuli rakh kar events ka intezar karta hai.

blocks.text: Tkinter ke components aur widgets

Tkinter bohat se components deta hai jinhein widgets kehte hain; in se interactive graphical applications banti hain. Aik program mein kai visual cheezein ho sakti hain, jaise windows, frames, buttons aur text fields. Widgets se user data likhta, options chunta ya koi kaam karta hai. Har widget ka apna maqsad hai, aur inhein mila kar poora interface banta hai. Tkinter layout management bhi deta hai taake widgets screen par saleeqe se rakhe ja sakein.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Aik main window banayein aur use do frames mein baantein. Layout munazzam karne ke liye har frame mein alag widgets dalein.
Window banana aur frames dalna

Tkinter program main window banane se shuru hota hai; yahi baqi sab cheezon ki bunyad hai. Window ka size badla ja sakta hai, us ko title diya ja sakta hai, aur us mein mukhtalif widgets rakhe ja sakte hain. Frames window ke andar hisse (sections) hain jo content ko munazzam karte hain. Frames window ko chhote hisson mein baant dete hain, is liye mutalliq widgets ko aik saath rakhna aasan hota hai. Is banawat se interface saaf aur saleeqe wala rehta hai.
Misal (Example):

import tkinter as tk

# Create main window
window = tk.Tk()
window.title("Tkinter Frames Example")
window.geometry("400x300")

# Create top frame
top_frame = tk.Frame(window, bg="lightblue", height=100)
top_frame.pack(fill="x")

# Create bottom frame
bottom_frame = tk.Frame(window, bg="lightgreen", height=200)
bottom_frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

# Add widgets to top frame
label_top = tk.Label(top_frame, text="Top Frame", bg="lightblue")
label_top.pack(pady=20)

# Add widgets to bottom frame
label_bottom = tk.Label(bottom_frame, text="Bottom Frame", bg="lightgreen")
label_bottom.pack(pady=50)

# Run the application
window.mainloop()

blocks.alt: Tkinter Frames Example window ka output: oopar halke neele rang ka frame jis mein Top Frame likha hai, neeche bara halka sabz frame jis mein Bottom Frame likha hai.
blocks.caption: Frames wali misal ka output (kitab mein code ke saath chhapi window ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Tk() → main window banata hai.
Frame → window ko hisson mein baant-ta hai.
top_frame aur bottom_frame → layout munazzam karte hain (oopar halka neela, neeche halka sabz).
pack() → frames aur widgets ko rakhta hai; fill="x" frame ko chaurai mein phailata hai, fill="both", expand=True bachi jagah bhar deta hai.
Frames GUI ko saaf aur munazzam rakhte hain.

blocks.text: Aam widgets: Labels, Buttons, Entry Fields, Menus aur List boxes

Widgets GUI banane ke bunyadi hisse hain. Label screen par text ya paigham dikhata hai. Button dabane par user koi kaam karta hai. Entry field mein text likha jata hai, jaise naam ya password. Menu window ke oopar options ki fehrist deta hai. Listbox cheezon ki fehrist dikhata hai aur us mein se chunne deta hai.
Layout Management

Layout management window ke andar widgets ko theek tarah tarteeb dene ke liye hai. Yeh screen par har widget ki jagah (position) aur size tay karti hai. Achhi layout management interface ko saaf aur aasan banati hai aur window ko munazzam rakhti hai. Tkinter layout ke liye mukhtalif methods deta hai, aur har method widgets ko apne tareeqe se rakhta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Theek layout management se applications saaf suthri nazar aati hain aur mukhtalif screen sizes par achhi chalti hain.
pack(), grid() aur place() se cheezein tarteeb dena

pack() method widgets ko saade tareeqe se aik ke neeche aik (vertical) ya aik ke saath aik (horizontal) rakhta hai; yeh aasan hai aur chhoti applications ke liye theek hai. grid() method widgets ko table ki tarah rows aur columns mein rakhta hai; yeh forms aur munazzam layouts ke liye mufeed hai. place() method widgets ko window par bilkul theek jagah (x aur y coordinates) par rakhta hai (Figure 4.2); is mein control zyada hai lekin ehtiyat se adjust karna parta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen windows saath saath. Pack(): Button 1, 2 aur 3 beech mein aik ke neeche aik. Grid(): Button 1 aur Button 2 aik row mein, neeche chaura Button 3 dono columns par phaila hua. Place(): Button 1 oopar baayein, Button 2 neeche daayein, Button 3 neeche baayein.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.2: Tkinter ke layout managers: pack(), grid(), place() (kitab ki Figure 4.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Misal pack():

import tkinter as tk

# Create main window
window = tk.Tk()
window.title("pack()")
window.geometry("300x220")

# Create buttons
button1 = tk.Button(window, text="Button 1", width=12)
button2 = tk.Button(window, text="Button 2", width=12)
button3 = tk.Button(window, text="Button 3", width=12)

# Arrange buttons using pack()
button1.pack(pady=10)
button2.pack(pady=10)
button3.pack(pady=10)

# Run the application
window.mainloop()
Misal grid():

import tkinter as tk

# Create main window
window = tk.Tk()
window.title("grid()")
window.geometry("300x220")

# Create buttons
button1 = tk.Button(window, text="Button 1", width=10)
button2 = tk.Button(window, text="Button 2", width=10)
button3 = tk.Button(window, text="Button 3", width=24)

# Arrange buttons using grid()
button1.grid(row=0, column=0, padx=10, pady=20)
button2.grid(row=0, column=1, padx=10, pady=20)

# Button 3 spans two columns
button3.grid(row=1, column=0, columnspan=2, padx=10, pady=10)

# Keep content centred
window.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
window.grid_columnconfigure(1, weight=1)

# Run the application
window.mainloop()
Misal place():

import tkinter as tk

# Create main window
window = tk.Tk()
window.title("place()")
window.geometry("300x220")

# Create buttons
button1 = tk.Button(window, text="Button 1", width=10)
button2 = tk.Button(window, text="Button 2", width=10)
button3 = tk.Button(window, text="Button 3", width=10)

# Arrange buttons using place()
button1.place(x=30, y=40)
button2.place(x=170, y=85)
button3.place(x=30, y=140)

# Run the application
window.mainloop()

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Teeno programs ka output (window) Figure 4.2 jaisa hai: pack() mein teeno buttons aik ke neeche aik; grid() mein Button 1 aur Button 2 aik row mein aur chaura Button 3 neeche dono columns par (columnspan=2); place() mein har button apne x, y par. Aik hi container (window ya frame) ke widgets ke liye pack() aur grid() ko na milayein, warna program atak sakta hai.
Saaf aur responsive interfaces banana

Saaf (clean) interface mein widgets saleeqe se rakhe hote hain aur un ke darmiyan kafi jagah hoti hai. Text aur buttons wazeh aur parhne mein aasan hone chahiye. Responsive interface window ka size badalne par apna layout badal leta hai, is liye program mukhtalif screen sizes par achha chalta hai. Theek alignment (seedh) application ki shakal behtar karta hai, aur saada design interface ko user-friendly banata hai.
Event handling aur interactivity

Event handling aur interactivity program ko user ke kaam ka jawab dene deti hain. Event aik kaam hai, jaise button dabana ya text likhna. Program har waqt chalte rehne ke bajaye event ka intezar karta hai. Event hone par aik khaas kaam hota hai. Is se application chust aur mufeed banti hai. Graphical programs mein event handling zaroori hai; yeh program ka rawayya control karti hai.
Event-driven programming samajhna

Event-driven programming events naam ke kaamon par chalti hai. Program event hone tak khamosh (idle) rehta hai. Aam events button click aur key press hain. Har event aik khaas function se jura hota hai, aur woh function sirf us waqt chalta hai jab event hota hai. Is tareeqe se computer ke wasail (system resources) bachte hain. GUI mein yeh tareeqa bohat istemal hota hai.

blocks.alt: Event loop ka chakkar: mainloop() event ka intezar karta hai; Login dabana event hai; is se check_login() chalta hai; messagebox paigham dikhata hai; phir mainloop() dobara intezar karta hai.
blocks.caption: Login misal mein event loop (hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.text: User input lena aur widgets ko functions se jorna

User entry fields aur buttons jaise widgets se input deta hai. Widgets program ke functions se jure hote hain; widget istemal hone par jura hua function chal jata hai aur input process karta hai. Maslan button click par paigham dikhaya ja sakta hai. Theek connections se program sahi chalta hai aur user ka tajurba behtar hota hai.
Misal: saada Login Form

Saada login form user ko username aur password likhne deta hai. Entry fields user se input lete hain. Maloomat bhejne (submit) ke liye button hota hai. Button dabane par program likha hua data check karta hai, phir kamyabi (success) ya ghalti (error) ka paigham dikhata hai.
Misal (Example):

import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox

# Create main window
window = tk.Tk()
window.title("Login Form")
window.geometry("300x200")

# Function to check login
def check_login():
    username = entry_user.get()
    password = entry_pass.get()

    # simple check
    if username == "admin" and password == "1234":
        messagebox.showinfo("Success", "Login Successful!")
    else:
        messagebox.showerror("Error", "Invalid Username or Password")

# Username label and entry
tk.Label(window, text="Username").pack()
entry_user = tk.Entry(window)
entry_user.pack()

# Password label and entry
tk.Label(window, text="Password").pack()
entry_pass = tk.Entry(window, show="*")
entry_pass.pack()

# Login button
tk.Button(window, text="Login", command=check_login).pack(pady=10)

# Run application
window.mainloop()

blocks.alt: Login program ka output: Login Form window jis mein Username aur Password ke labels aur entry fields aur Login button hain. Us ke oopar alag Success message box hai: maloomat (information) ka nishan, Login Successful! aur ok button.
blocks.caption: Login form misal ka output: Login Form window aur Success message box (kitab mein code ke saath chhapi windows ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Login button dabane par check_login() chalta hai. Username 'admin' aur password '1234' hon to messagebox.showinfo() aik alag chhoti window (pop-up) kholta hai jis ka unwan Success hai aur jis mein Login Successful! likha hota hai; ok dabane par yeh band ho jati hai. Ghalat ho to showerror() Error wali window dikhata hai. Paigham form ke andar nahi, alag window mein aata hai.

items: Entry → username aur password leta hai; show="*" likhte waqt password chhupata hai.
Button → data bhejta hai: command=check_login click par check chalata hai.
check_login() → get() se input parh kar check karta hai.
messagebox → kamyabi (showinfo) ya ghalti (showerror) ka paigham alag window mein dikhata hai.
Poora program event-driven programming par chalta hai.

blocks.title: Asli passwords kabhi code mein na rakhein
blocks.text: Seekhne ke liye program mein 'admin' aur '1234' likhna theek hai, lekin asli applications passwords kabhi code mein nahi rakhtin. Woh har password ka mehfooz hash, aam taur par database mein, rakhti aur hashes ka muqabla karti hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Event-driven concepts samjhayein, phir students aisa button banayein jo click par label ka text badal de.

blocks.prompt: Button command=greet ke bajaye command=greet() se banaya gaya. Kya ghalat hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Qausain ke saath greet() button bante waqt aik dafa chal jata hai aur us ki wapas aane wali qeemat (aam taur par None) command ban jati hai, is liye click par kuch nahi hota. command= ko function khud, qausain ke baghair, dena chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Aise form ke liye kaun sa layout method use karenge jis mein labels aik column aur entry fields agle column mein hon? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: grid(), kyunke yeh widgets rows aur columns mein rakhta hai, is liye har label aur us ki entry aik hi row mein seedh mein aate hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: GUI: visual interface; Tkinter: Python ka built-in toolkit (Tk(), widgets, mainloop()).
Widgets: Label, Button, Entry, Menu, Listbox; frames widgets ko groups mein rakhte.
Layouts: pack() (aik ke baad aik), grid() (rows aur columns), place() (bilkul x, y).
Event-driven: command= widget ko function se jorta hai jo event par chalta hai.
